title: fix(i18n): zh admin-override copy says 管理员代为/代办, not 越权 (objectui#13402)
body:
Closes #13402
Clause-②: no

## What changed

In zh-CN the authorized admin-override approval copy called the override 越权 ("exceeding one's authority", the word for a violation). The feature is an explicitly granted, audited administrator override, so the zh pack now says:

| key | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `approvalsInbox.overrideActionLabel` | `越权{{action}}` | `管理员代为{{action}}` (管理员代为通过 / 拒绝 / 转签 / 撤回) |
| `approvalsInbox.viaOverrideChip` | 管理员越权 | 管理员代办 |
| `approvalsInbox.viaOverrideHint` | …经管理员越权通道进入。 | …经管理员代办通道进入。 |
| `overrideNotice`, `overrideNoticeWho`, `overrideReassignNotice`, `overrideReassignNoticeWho`, `overrideRecallNotice`, `overrideRecallNoticeWho` | 继续将使用管理员越权… / …记录为管理员越权。 | 继续将以管理员身份代为处理… / …记录为管理员代办。 |

`{{action}}` is the lever's declared label, localized (`declaredLabel` in `DeclaredActionsBar`), so the label reads 管理员代为通过 and so on. The rest of each sentence, every `{{who}}` / `{{action}}` placeholder, and each line's own punctuation style (two lines use ASCII `:`/`,`, the others full-width) are unchanged. Only the zh pack changes; en and the other locales are out of scope.

`viaOverrideHint` is the ninth 越权 line in `zh.ts` and describes the same override path, so it is covered too. The repo-wide grep for 越权 also hits the vendored `.objectstack-pin/spec/CHANGELOG.md`, where 越权读 means a real unauthorized read. That use is correct and it is not this repo's copy, so it is untouched.

## Tests

- New pin `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/approvalOverride-zh-wording-13402.test.ts`: every zh `approvalsInbox` string is free of 越权 (the enumeration is asserted non-empty first); the label is `管理员代为{{action}}` and renders 管理员代为通过 / 拒绝 / 转签 / 撤回; the chip is 管理员代办; each of the nine override keys keeps the placeholders of its en source; the matcher's own positive and negative cases.
- Ablation: with `zh.ts` reverted to the base, 2 of the pin's 12 tests fail (the no-越权 test and the label/chip test). Restored, 12/12 pass.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.overrideAffordance.test.tsx`: 86 files passed, 1362 tests passed, 13 skipped. This includes `all-locales-key-parity` and `en-zh-key-parity`.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: 4/4 tasks successful.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `check-changeset-presence`: exit 0. ESLint on the touched files: exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, reason: it reads a built console bundle (`apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`), which was not built locally. CI reads it.

Changeset: `.changeset/13402-zh-override-wording.md`, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.
